📍 Startup India, DPIIT at AIC-SMUTBI, Sikkim

Shri Ateesh Kumar Singh, Additional Secretary, DPIIT, graced the North-East Entrepreneurs' Meet 2026 at AIC-SMUTBI, Sikkim Manipal University, as Chief Guest on 27 September 2026.

In his address, Shri Ateesh Kumar Singh celebrated the immense entrepreneurial potential of the Northeast, urging the region to embrace and build on its own distinctive strengths, such as organic agriculture, tourism, wellness, and natural resources, to create globally competitive businesses rooted in local identity. He highlighted the evolving DPIIT policy framework, including expanded recognition norms for DeepTech startups and cooperative societies, designed to meet founders where they are. He also emphasised the importance of incubators, market access, and cross-regional collaboration in helping ambitious founders scale from the Northeast to the nation and beyond.

Dr. Tej Chingtham, CEO, AIC-SMUTBI and Member, National Startup Advisory Council, delivered the welcome address, setting the tone for the Meet by reaffirming AIC-SMUTBI's commitment to nurturing early-stage innovation and technology-led entrepreneurship across the region.

Shri Ateesh Kumar Singh also met with the Mumbai Dabbawalas, who shared insights from their renowned logistics and delivery model during the event.

🌱C-CAMP, in collaboration with Ashraya Hastha Trust, has selected 11 innovations to drive climate action and sustainability in India and the world! #CCAMP #ClimateChange #Innovations #sustainability
 
These startups are working at the interface of climate change with healthcare, agriculture, and the environment, and represent the 1st cohort of the Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Sustainability & Climate Action at C-CAMP. 
 
The selected startups are —
 
* GenePath Diagnostics (climate x healthcare): a room-temperature stable open PCR platform for One Health detection of tropical vector-borne pathogens
* Prodancy Pvt Ltd (climate x healthcare): reusable peristaltic pulse lavage system
* AeroDel Technology Innovations Pvt Ltd (climate x healthcare): climate-responsive airway clearance & respiratory monitoring solutions for pollution and heat-stressed populations

* Intello Labs (climate x agri): AI-powered quality digitisation and digital market infrastructure for efficient fresh produce trade
* String Bio Private Limited (climate x agri): methane-derived growth stimulants for climate-resilient sugarcane production
* Tealaa Innovations (climate x agri): robotic sludge management system designed for aquaculture ponds

* Ossus Biorenewables (climate x environment): decarbonising industrial effluents using bio-electrochemical OB hydracel bioreactor and generating green hydrogen
* #BPC Bioproducts amylo(climate x environment): commercialising sustainable packaging with tailored biodegradable plastic solutions for India
* EarthKind Innovations Foods Biotech (climate x environment): programmable lipid platform using agricultural residue feedstocks
 * Intrinsic Foundries (climate x environment): microalgae-based point-source CO₂ capture & high-value biochemical biorefinery platform
* #BisketLabs (climate x environment): bio-based printed circuit board (PCB) substrates from agri-waste for circular electronics manufacturing

The CoE will offer these startups —
 🔸Funding support of up to INR 50 lakhs, 
 🔸Access to high-end incubation labs, 
 🔸Scientific and business mentorship, 
 🔸Assistance with scale-up for market deployment, and 
 🔸Networking opportunities

C-CAMP - supported, Udupi-based startup BlackFrog receives strong support from Hon’ble Minister Jyotiraditya M Scindia for taking life-saving vaccines to hard-to-reach locations in India’s North East, through its innovative cold-chain vaccine carrier technology.

In partnership with C-CAMP, Blackfrog has enabled the delivery of emergency vaccines and critical medical supplies — including insulin, blood products, breast milk and medical specimens — to some of the remotest locations in Assam and Manipur.

Its active cold-chain technology, Emvolio, maintains the required 2–8°C temperature range, preventing temperature-sensitive medicines and vaccines from degrading or losing their efficacy during last-mile transportation — helping ensure life-saving healthcare supplies reach even the hardest-to-reach communities safely and effectively

With C-CAMP’s support, the technology has also been deployed in remote locations across Karnataka and Tamil Nadu.

C-CAMP has also supported Blackfrog through multiple programmes, including IT BT Department, Karnataka #KSAPBIO50 cohort, Atal Innovation Mission Official #SeedFund cohort, and the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC) COVID Fund cohort; Blackfrog is also a #NBEC2019 winner.

Thank you, Hon'ble Minister, for your encouraging words!

Sustain Plus is one of 33 finalists for the 2027 Zayed Sustainability Prize!!
 
Sustain Plus began with a shared diagnosis. Proven clean energy solutions were reaching rural India as pilots, however, very few were able to create scale. The missing piece was everything around the technology: finance, service networks, markets and public systems.
 
Hence, Sustain Plus reversed the usual sequence. It starts with a community's own aspirations. It works through the institutions people already trust. The technology comes last, and the community helps choose it.
 
This recognition belongs first to the communities who own and run these solutions. It also belongs to our implementation, government, technology and funding partners, who made the work possible.
 
The goal remains 10 million people by 2030.
 
Thank you, Zayed Sustainability Prize. Congratulations to all the finalists!

B2B or B2C? Your customer decides how you should go to market. 👇

A strong product is only one part of the equation. Your Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy needs to change based on who you're selling to.

In B2B, buying decisions often involve multiple stakeholders, longer evaluation cycles, business value, reliability, and measurable results.

In B2C, the journey is often more direct, with factors such as price, convenience, brand, experience, and customer preference playing a major role.

For startups, understanding this difference can help you make better decisions around:

🔹 Who your real decision-maker is
🔹 What motivates your customer to buy
🔹 Where you should reach them
🔹 How your sales journey should work
🔹 Which metrics actually matter
